# Generated by ppc logistics apply from [logistics] in constructor.toml (logistics.py); do not edit by hand.

# Location scope: max_levels of the logistics buildings (2026-10-23, Jan): one logistics level at a time per
# location. The cap is the levels built, plus one while this building has the level under construction or no
# logistics building in the location has one. The engine counts levels under construction against max_levels, so a
# second level of any logistics building can start only after the first is finished, and the allow gate (market
# access, building levels) is checked again for every new level. A site cap from [logistics] level_caps clamps it.
pp_carrier_inn_logistics_max_level = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_LOGISTICS_BUILT"
		value = "location_building_level(building_type:carrier_inn)"
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					building_type = building_type:carrier_inn
					building_levels_under_construction >= 1
				}
				NOT = {
					any_buildings_in_location = {
						OR = {
							building_type = building_type:carrier_inn
							building_type = building_type:coastal_shipping_office
							building_type = building_type:pp_banjara_tanda
							building_type = building_type:pp_caravanserai
							building_type = building_type:pp_llama_caravan_post
							building_type = building_type:pp_oasis_caravan_station
							building_type = building_type:pp_yam_station
							building_type = building_type:river_boatmen_yard
							building_type = building_type:transport_office
						}
						building_levels_under_construction >= 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_LOGISTICS_NEXT" value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					building_type = building_type:carrier_inn
					building_levels_under_construction >= 1
				}
			}
			any_buildings_in_location = {
				OR = {
					building_type = building_type:carrier_inn
					building_type = building_type:coastal_shipping_office
					building_type = building_type:pp_banjara_tanda
					building_type = building_type:pp_caravanserai
					building_type = building_type:pp_llama_caravan_post
					building_type = building_type:pp_oasis_caravan_station
					building_type = building_type:pp_yam_station
					building_type = building_type:river_boatmen_yard
					building_type = building_type:transport_office
				}
				building_levels_under_construction >= 1
			}
		}
		add = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_LOGISTICS_BUSY" value = 0 }
	}
}
